subject: Phase 5: Cutover to containers
description: Pause pm2 autodeploy crons. pm2 stop apps, final delta dump->restore, re-verify counts. Stop aaPanel nginx, start Caddy on 80/443. Verify both domains serve HTTPS with data + Caddy LE cert. Staging first then prod. Rollback path: stop Caddy, start nginx + pm2 resurrect.
